x: Shepherd, 7 min. 28 secs. 4 x 110 yards relay; 2nd., Bels. (Rae, Picton, Tebbutt, Marshall).

In the Junior 4 x 110 yards relay our team comprising: Marshall, Tebbutt, Rae and Sexton, in that order, won their heat in 45,5 secs. In the final they drew lane 4, on the outside, and thanks to an almost super human effort by Alan Sexton, after bad baton handling earlier, won in 45.3 secs.

Sexton won his first heat in 24.1; Tebbutt won his first heat in 24.6; Picton, Marshall and Rae were each second in their heats. Sexton beat Marshall in the second round in 23.6; Picton won his second round in 23.9.
Handicap Team Race: 1, Belgrave H. “C,” 203 mins. (Tebbutt, McGreechan, Jarlett, Warr); 3, Belgrave H. “A,” 207.54 (McMullen, James, Readman, Bidgood).
